name: Organisation
definition: Organised structure that is set up for a particular purpose. For example, a business, government body, department, charity, or financial institution.

Purpose.name: Purpose
Purpose.definition: Purpose of the organisation, eg, charity.

RegistrationDate.name: Registration Date
RegistrationDate.definition: Date and time at which a given organisation was officially registered.

EstablishmentDate.name: Establishment Date
EstablishmentDate.definition: Date when the organisation was established.

EntityExpirationDate.name: Entity Expiration Date
EntityExpirationDate.definition: The date the Legal Entity ceased operation or was merged. This element SHALL be present if EntityExpirationReason is present, and omitted otherwise.

EntityExpirationReason.name: Entity Expiration Reason
EntityExpirationReason.definition: Reason that a Legal Entity ceased to operate. This element SHALL be present if EntityExpirationDate is present, and omitted otherwise.

MerchantCategory.name: Merchant Category
MerchantCategory.definition: Classification of a business by the types of goods or services it provides.

EntitySize.name: Entity Size
EntitySize.definition: Size of the entity according to a taxonomy defined in a regulation.

OrganisationIdentification.name: Organisation Identification
OrganisationIdentification.definition: Specific identification assigned to an organisation. It is derived from the association between Party and PartyIdentification.

ParentOrganisation.name: Parent Organisation
ParentOrganisation.definition: Organisation which is divided in branches.

Branch.name: Branch
Branch.definition: Specifies an organisation which is not a head office.

SecuritiesModification.name: Securities Modification
SecuritiesModification.definition: Specifies the process which originates the changes to an organisation.

PlaceOfOperation.name: Place Of Operation
PlaceOfOperation.definition: Place (including country) in which the organisation has its business activity.

PlaceOfRegistration.name: Place Of Registration
PlaceOfRegistration.definition: Place (including country) in which the organisation is registered.

Sector.name: Sector
Sector.definition: Sector of business of the organisation, for example, pharmaceutical.

RelatedIndicationOfInterest.name: Related Indication Of Interest
RelatedIndicationOfInterest.definition: Indication of interest process for which a list of organisations is specified.

OrganisationHierarchy.name: Organisation Hierarchy
OrganisationHierarchy.definition: Description of the structure of a company.

RepresentativeOfficer.name: Representative Officer
RepresentativeOfficer.definition: Officer who has some rights to represent a given organisation. In account management, it is the person to be contacted by the account servicer.

RelatedUltimateCreditrorEnrolmentService.name: Related Ultimate Creditror Enrolment Service
RelatedUltimateCreditrorEnrolmentService.definition: Enrolment service for the ultimate party to which an amount of money is due.

RelatedCreditrorEnrolmentService.name: Related Creditror Enrolment Service
RelatedCreditrorEnrolmentService.definition: Enrolment service for the party to which an amount of money is due.

RelatedPostTradeRiskReduction.name: Related Post Trade Risk Reduction
RelatedPostTradeRiskReduction.definition: Post trade risk reduction for which the organisation is the structurer.
